WFP_DESC_FPSLIMITMENUS: Limits the front-end and pause menus. 0 is unlimited; Monitor follows the display refresh rate.
WFP_DESC_SKIPINTRO: Skips the movies and the title screen when you launch the game.
WFP_DESC_U2SAVEBONUS: A new career gets the 10000 bonus cash the game gives for an Underground 2 save, without looking for one.
WFP_DESC_SKIPINTRO_U2: Skips startup movies, the title screen and the first profile-loaded confirmation. Profile choices and error messages remain available.
WFP_DESC_FPSLIMIT: The highest frame rate the game runs at.
WFP_DESC_WINDOWED: How the game's window is shown.
WFP_DESC_SAVEFOLDER: Stores saves and settings in this folder inside the game's folder, for example "save".
WFP_DESC_HUDASPECT: Constrains the HUD to an aspect ratio such as 16:9 or 21:9, or a custom ratio. Auto uses the whole screen.
WFP_DESC_DEADZONE: Part of the stick's travel that is ignored, in percent.
WFP_DESC_FREELOOK: Orbit the chase camera with the right stick or the mouse.
WFP_DESC_STICKSENSITIVITY: How fast the right stick turns the free look camera.
WFP_DESC_MOUSESENSITIVITY: How fast the mouse turns the free look camera.
WFP_DESC_INVERTLOOK: Inverts the up and down look of the free look camera, for the right stick and the mouse.
WFP_DESC_RETURNDELAY: Seconds before the camera returns behind the car.
WFP_DESC_RETURNSPEED: How fast the camera swings back behind the moving car.
WFP_DESC_DRIFTCAMERA: The chase camera behaves as in drift races everywhere: it no longer pulls back when accelerating or closes in when braking.
WFP_DESC_HORIZONTALSTICK: The right stick only turns the camera sideways, for when its vertical axis is bound to something else, such as shifting.
WFP_DESC_SCALING: How the field of view widens with the screen's aspect ratio.
WFP_DESC_FOV: Multiplies the driving cameras' field of view. 1.0 keeps the intended framing; larger values widen it. Menus, movies and other camera movers keep their own views. Native angle limits still apply.
WFP_DESC_CONSOLEGAMMA: A gamma curve with more contrast and deeper colours.
WFP_DESC_CONSOLEGAMMA_MW: On: a gamma curve with more contrast and deeper colours. Xbox 360: the gamma of the Xbox 360 version of the game.
WFP_DESC_SMAA: Post-processing antialiasing. Doesn't work together with MSAA.
WFP_DESC_ANTIALIASING: SMAA smooths the edges of each picture.
WFP_DESC_HIDEAABUG: Draws 1 pixel lines at the screen's edges to hide the antialiasing bug of MSAA.
WFP_DESC_LANGUAGE: The game's language. Only installed languages are offered.
WFP_DESC_RAINDROPLETS: Size of the rain droplets on the screen. No effect with Xbox Rain Droplets installed.
WFP_DESC_SUBTITLES: Shows subtitles in the movies, in every language.
WFP_DESC_WRITESETTINGS: Stores the game's registry settings in Settings.ini in the profile folder instead of the registry. Enter your CD key there when using this.
WFP_DESC_SHADOWSRES: Resolution of the dynamic shadows. Higher is sharper.
WFP_DESC_MOTIONBLUR: Motion blur. Turning it off keeps the other screen effects.
WFP_DESC_CONTRAILS: The wind trails behind fast cars.
WFP_DESC_SCENERYLOD: Shows the last scenery detail step too: more scenery in the distance, which may flicker farther away.
WFP_DESC_PRECULLER: The precomputed visibility (preculling). Turning it off shows some scenery it wrongly hides.
WFP_DESC_BRUTEFORCECULLING: Checks every scenery section instead of the visibility tree: less missing scenery, but slower.
WFP_DESC_CSMSCALE: Overall size of the shadow cascades. Larger is farther shadows at lower quality.
WFP_DESC_CSMSCALENEAR: Size of the nearest shadow cascade. The original is 5.
WFP_DESC_CSMSCALEMID: Size of the middle shadow cascade. The original is 30.
WFP_DESC_CSMSCALEFAR: Size of the farthest shadow cascade. The original is 170.
WFP_DESC_BLOOM: Strength of the bloom effect. 1 is the original, 0 turns it off.
WFP_DESC_FMVMODE: Original Aspect: the whole movie framed as in the original game. Fill Screen: the whole movie fitted to the screen. Nothing is cut off.
WFP_DESC_CUTSCENEBORDERS: Black bars in the in-game cutscenes. Letterbox: the bars above and below that the original shows. Pillarbox: bars at the sides on screens wider than 16:9, which keep the cutscenes' framing.
WFP_DESC_ANIMATEDBORDERS: The cutscene bars slide in and out like the original's. Off shows and hides them at once.
WFP_DESC_CUTSCENEBORDERS_NIS: Black bars in the in-game cutscenes (race intros and other scenes played in the game's engine). Pillarbox: bars at the sides on screens wider than 16:9, which keep the cutscenes' framing. This version of the game draws no bars above and below, so Letterbox shows none and Both is the same as Pillarbox.
WFP_DESC_CONFINECURSOR: Keep the cursor inside the active game client area. Releases on focus loss, window dragging, system menus or when disabled. Independent of mouse input.
WFP_DESC_TEXTLANGUAGE: Language of the texts in the Plugins menu. Automatic follows the game language.
WFP_NFSU_PLUGINS_DESCRIPTION: Adjust the Fusion Fix and other plugins
WFP_RESTOREDEFAULTS_HELP: Sets this page's settings to their defaults.
WFP_PRESET_HELP: Vanilla: the original game with only bugs fixed. Recommended: the modern setup. Enhanced: everything on.
WFP_RESTART_WARNING: Restart the game to apply the changed settings.
WFP_DESC_CONSOLELIGHTING: Use Xbox 360 lighting, including the rear-view mirror. Off keeps the original PC lighting. Requires a restart.
WFP_DESC_RAWINPUT: Use unaccelerated mouse movement for free look. Changes apply immediately. The menu cursor keeps its usual behavior.
WFP_DESC_PAUSEONFOCUSLOSS: Pause and mute the game when switching to another window. Turn off to keep it running in the background.
checkforupdates.description: Once per start, asks fusionfix.io whether a newer version of the fix is out and tells you in the game. Off makes no network request.
update.availablehub: {name} {version} is available. FusionFixHub opens when you close the game.
